candidates.training_data_status: Deezer internal datasets; public training corpus unavailable due copyright constraints
candidates.reason: Historical JOSS text describes code and pretrained models as MIT-distributed, but current repository language identifies code as MIT and GitHub issue #957 remains open without a Deezer maintainer answer on commercial weight use, conversion, and redistribution.

candidates.training_data_status: MUSDB/MUSDB-HQ plus additional corpus depending on model
candidates.reason: A Demucs author/contributor states official model weights are not covered by MIT and are provided only for scientific purposes; MUSDB family data is also not a default commercial-training corpus.

candidates.training_data_status: rights-cleared project-owned/commissioned real multitracks plus optional CC BY 4.0 Slakh2100 supplementary synthetic data
conditions: do not initialize from official Demucs, Spleeter, or Open-Unmix pretrained weights
do not use MUSDB18 or MUSDB18-HQ for commercial training without separate express rights
every real training item requires explicit commercial ML-training and resulting-weight rights
maintain training manifest with dataset rights record IDs and output weight hashes
validate on rights-cleared real multi-genre audio; synthetic-only quality evidence is insufficient

selected_path.training_corpus: rights-cleared project-owned or commissioned real multitracks; Slakh2100 only supplementary
selected_path.why: This is the shortest path currently identified that avoids unresolved or explicitly noncommercial pretrained-weight rights while preserving a route to high-quality multi-stem separation.

optional_fast_track.path: written commercial license/procurement from a separator vendor such as Spleeter Pro
required_terms: commercial inference grant for intended server topology
conversion and redistribution grant if an on-device derivative is later required
retention, support, and termination terms compatible with production
